fact: The MGLSD feasibility report says numerous Ugandan social protection programmes operate their own management information systems, including those for the Senior Citizens Grant, the Youth Livelihood Programme and SAGE.
system: programme MISs (Senior Citizens Grant, Youth Livelihood Programme, SAGE)

fact: The MGLSD feasibility report says the MISs of various programmes are linked to the National Single Registry, which provides an integrated beneficiary management platform.

Development Pathways says Uganda's Ministry of Gender, Labour and Social Development commissioned the digital National Single Registry on 4 February 2021, with WFP supporting its implementation and maintenance since 2020.
Development Pathways says the National Single Registry consolidates information on beneficiaries across multiple social protection schemes and integrates the WFP Karamoja Social Registry.
